artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from moderate generative artifacts typical of complex architectural scenes. Additionally, the background elements (rose window, upper arches) exhibit a painterly softness and lack of geometric precision compared to the foreground, indicating depth/texture generation issues. These are not catastrophic but are noticeable upon close inspection, preventing a perfect artifact score.
